title: Optimal Input-Space Partitioning for HATF
summary: Proper input-space partitioning can improve the precision of Higher-order Algebraic Transitional Form bias estimates, but finding better or optimal partitioning methods remains open.

formal_statement.body: Find an optimal input-space partitioning method for improving HATF precision.

scope.domain: The problem concerns input-space partitioning for the Higher-order Algebraic Transitional Form (HATF) in higher-order differential-linear cryptanalysis.
parameters: Input-space partition, whose choice affects the precision of HATF bias estimates
scope.unresolved_remainder: Find better or optimal methods for partitioning the input space to improve HATF precision.

citations.label: Revisiting Higher-Order Differential-Linear Attacks from an Algebraic Perspective

progress.summary: The source reports that proper input-space partitioning improves HATF precision and explicitly asks how to find better or even optimal methods. The paper uses cipher-specific partitions but provides no optimal selection method.
citation_labels: Kai Hu et al., Revisiting Higher-Order Differential-Linear Attacks from an Algebraic Perspective
